cathedralplatform.name: Strasbourg Cathedral
cathedralplatform.slogan: A pink sandstone spire that out-reached the whole world.
cathedralplatform.line: It is a marvel of the gigantic and the delicate.
cathedralplatform.by: Victor Hugo, Le Rhin, letter on Strasbourg, 1842

petitefrancetanneurs.name: Petite France
petitefrancetanneurs.slogan: Half-timbered tanners' houses leaning over the Ill.
petitefrancetanneurs.line: The name comes from a 1503 hospice for soldiers with syphilis, then called the French disease.

hautkoenigsbourg.name: Haut-Kœnigsbourg Castle
hautkoenigsbourg.slogan: A ruin rebuilt as the Middle Ages the Kaiser dreamed of.
hautkoenigsbourg.line: Swedish troops burned it in 1633 after a 52-day siege; it was rebuilt from 1900 to 1908 under Wilhelm II.

pontscouverts.name: Ponts Couverts
pontscouverts.slogan: Three bridges and four towers, still guarding the Ill.
pontscouverts.line: Their wooden roofs came off in 1784, yet the name Covered Bridges stuck for good.

montsainteodile.name: Mont Sainte-Odile
montsainteodile.slogan: A convent above the forest, ringed by an ancient wall.
montsainteodile.line: A 10 km prehistoric wall, the Heidenmauer, circles the 764 m summit of the convent.
